name: Yuki Sato
headline: Senior Android Developer
summary: Android developer with 6 years building Kotlin apps for ride-hailing and mobile games. Focused on smooth UIs, small APKs and builds that stay fast as the codebase grows.

experience.title: Senior Android Developer
bullets: Lead the Android app for a ride-hailing service with 2.5 million monthly riders, written entirely in Kotlin.
Rewrote the booking screens with Jetpack Compose, cutting crash-free session failures by 60%.
Split the app into 30 Gradle modules and brought clean build time from 11 minutes to 4.
Designed the offline-first sync between the app and the trip REST APIs.

experience.title: Android Developer
bullets: Built Kotlin features for two casual puzzle games on Android with 4 million installs between them.
Implemented in-app purchases and cut checkout drop-off by 18%.
Turned Figma designs into animated Android views with the art team, and introduced Git branching rules for releases.
